🇺🇸🇺🇸 “America, today I honestly feel embarrassed to even look my own children in the eyes. Because I have suddenly realized something that is truly making me question myself. I have watched Trump’s presidency. I have stood behind his work. But I never — not even ONE SINGLE TIME — stopped to thank the two men standing right beside him who have sacrificed so much along the way. Marco Rubio. Pete Hegseth. And today, I want to finally change that.

These are much more than simply cabinet members. They are two of the strongest pillars helping support Trump’s entire presidency.

Marco Rubio — the son of a Cuban immigrant who worked as a bartender — giving almost every part of his life to serving America through diplomacy, traveling around the world, representing this nation on international stages, spending long periods away from his loved ones, and carrying the enormous responsibility of protecting America’s relationships with countries across the globe.

Pete Hegseth — a combat veteran who has already dedicated years to serving his country in uniform — now once again accepting an enormous responsibility, leading the most powerful military on earth, bringing important reforms, and facing political battles in Washington that can be just as challenging as the battlefields where he once served.

Just pause for a moment and think about everything these two men have given up.

Their families sit around dinner tables where their chairs are sometimes empty. Their children may go to bed without seeing their fathers. Their wives take care of the household, raise the children, and manage everything at home — often by themselves — while their husbands continue their duty of serving America.

And yet, so many of us have never stopped for a moment to simply say —

Thank you. We recognize what you have sacrificed. We truly appreciate everything you do.

So today — at this very moment — I want those words to finally be heard. Thank you, Marco Rubio. Thank you, Pete Hegseth. You are Trump’s right hand and left hand. You are two strong pillars helping keep this entire mission moving forward. You have sacrificed your personal comfort, valuable time, and precious family moments — for 330 million Americans, many of whom may not even fully know your names. We see you. We respect you. We honor you. 🙏🇺🇸

And today, I want EVERYONE to join me in this prayer —

“Lord, please continue to watch over Marco Rubio and Pete Hegseth. Protect them and their families, and bless them with safety and good health. Give them the courage, wisdom, and strength to continue this mission alongside President Trump. And let them feel — even if only for a short moment — the gratitude of every American they work so tirelessly to serve each and every day.” 😭🙏🇺🇸

💔 Type “THANK YOU MARCO. THANK YOU PETE. — because these two men deserve to hear those words from Americans everywhere today. Tag someone who should recognize these often-forgotten heroes of Trump’s administration — because men who serve as such powerful pillars deserve to be recognized, appreciated, and acknowledged.

This is not the kind of Shabbat message I usually want to share, but I feel compelled to share an experience I had today.

I am currently in Scotland visiting my mother, and today I went for a haircut at Westend Hair in Glasgow.

I mentioned to the man cutting my hair that I was visiting from Israel. He immediately asked whether I was worried about Israel, given that it had, in his words, alienated the entire world.

Within about ten minutes, he had told me that Israel was responsible for the worldwide tsunami of Jew-hate, that 7 October was an inside job, and implied that the massacre was a reaction to 80 years of Israeli actions. He also claimed that the attack at Bondi would never have happened without the war in Gaza, and responded to Jew-hate with the equivalent of “all lives matter”.

I shut down the conversation, but it was an extremely uncomfortable and depressing experience. What made it worse was that he was in the middle of cutting my hair. I couldn't simply get up and leave. 

I am so utterly sick of non-Jews presuming to tell Jews what Jew-hate is, what causes it and how we should understand our own experiences. The confidence with which some people dismiss Jewish experiences while insisting that their own understanding is more legitimate is astonishing.

I could not be more glad that I made Aliyah. Experiences like this remind me why I am so happy to call Israel home.

Shabbat Shalom. May we all find some peace this Shabbat.

St Alban's, founded in 1772, is Warrington's oldest surviving Catholic parish and a Grade II listed church.

Courage Is What Separates Leaders from the Rest in the Greatest Crisis of Our Time.

In the greatest crisis of modern history, those who endure are the ones who have the courage to stand their ground.

Going to war takes courage. Avoiding endless wars is a legitimate choice. But allowing fear of war to trap you in an endless state of neither war nor peace is far worse than fighting an actual war.

Iran’s regime leaders know they may not survive the next American strike. Yet they continue to declare their willingness to fight to drive America out of the Middle East and acquire nuclear weapons.

Meanwhile, JD Vance is afraid of fighting, apparently to avoid a few extra dollars at the gas pump. Even if the price is changing the rules governing the passage of American warships through the Strait of Hormuz. Even if it means allowing a terrorist regime to acquire nuclear weapons and missiles capable of reaching the United States.

In the end, it is the mindset of the leaders on both sides, not the sophistication of their weapons or the superiority of America’s naval forces, that will determine the outcome.

History is changed by leaders like Churchill, not by timid politicians who, in the middle of the greatest crisis of our time, are preoccupied with grocery bills and their weekend vacations.

The face of fear in the American administration was exposed the day JD Vance sat in the Oval Office and shouted at Zelensky, a man whose defiance against Russian aggression had helped shape the course of history, demanding to know why he wasn’t grateful enough to America.

Vance’s ideas, implemented by an incompetent negotiator like Steve Witkoff, have kept the world in a state of neither war nor peace for seven months. Meanwhile, the criminal rulers of the Islamic Republic have been attacking oil tankers with their missiles, while Vance and his associates desperately plead for negotiations to resume.

War requires courage. So do negotiations. So does making a deal.

JD Vance has shown remarkably little of it.

items.t: Let’s talk about Kirill Dmitriev. Who is he, and why the hell is Putin’s sanctioned envoy being welcomed into the White House? It’s not for peace talks. Dmitri
items.tx:
Let’s talk about Kirill Dmitriev.

Who is he, and why the hell is Putin’s sanctioned envoy being welcomed into the White House?

It’s not for peace talks. 

Dmitriev isn’t a career diplomat. He’s a former Goldman Sachs banker who has run Russia’s sovereign wealth fund, the Russian Direct Investment Fund, since 2011. He is a close Putin associate and was appointed Putin’s special presidential envoy for international investment and economic cooperation in 2025. The US Treasury sanctioned him and his investment fund in February 2022, explicitly identifying him as a close Putin ally and describing the fund as an instrument of Putin’s inner circle.

He’s been building financial relationships with Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar and China. He’s also been a recurring back-channel contact with Trump’s inner circle. In 2017, he sought access to Trump’s incoming administration. His reconciliation proposal reached Jared Kushner through intermediaries. He also met Erik Prince in the Seychelles. This is documented in the Mueller investigation.

In 2020, reporting revealed that Kushner maintained a private communications channel with Dmitriev. They discussed investment opportunities, international negotiations and even the Russian-funded ventilator shipment to New York.

In 2025 and 2026, Dmitriev became a central figure in Trump’s negotiations with Putin over Ukraine. He’s also been pushing for sanctions relief for Russia’s investment fund. And now he’s back in Washington, welcomed into the White House, where Trump met with him privately.

There’s another part of this story that deserves scrutiny.

The White House is giving Melania Trump considerable credit for the Oleshky ceasefire. But Pope Leo had already been working on this humanitarian crisis. He personally called Putin on October 16 to request a ceasefire, humanitarian assistance and safe evacuation. He spoke with Zelenskyy three days later. Cardinal Zuppi had been pressing the issue for weeks.

The Vatican’s diplomatic intervention is documented. The precise extent of Melania’s subsequent negotiating role has not been independently explained. And somehow, the central figure at the White House celebration is Putin’s sanctioned economic and diplomatic envoy.

Why is he here?

What is he negotiating? What is he offering? What is Putin expecting in return? And why is the American president privately meeting with Putin’s representative while Ukrainian officials are left out?

This man isn’t here simply to celebrate a humanitarian evacuation. He’s here representing Putin’s economic and political interests.

Americans deserve to know what is being negotiated in our name.

Just finished listening to Ron Baron's fireside with Elon.

A few things that stuck:

SpaceX's best-guess ARR path is still enormous. Over $100 billion by the end of 2026, over $500 billion by the end of 2027, and a trillion no longer treated as fantasy. He was careful to call it a guess, not a promise.

On compute: the first StarMind machines, co-designed with NVIDIA, could start launching around Q3 2027. The logic is simple. If you try to add something like 200 gigawatts of AI a year on the ground, you're asking the U.S. grid to grow about 40% every year. That isn't happening. So the big iron goes to orbit.

Terafab is real estate with a punchline. Production in Grimes County near Texas A&M, research at Giga Texas, built in phases, and possibly a trillion dollars over time. The scale target is roughly thirty times next year's global AI-chip power capacity. And yes, he played the terror / Terra / Tera joke.

On spectrum, he didn't dance: if SpaceX can use spectrum ten times better than a legacy telco, acquiring that telco for the licenses is on the table.

And on hardware, he put Tesla and SpaceX at the top of the class outside China, and wasn't sure who'd be third even if you include China.

Optimistic, aggressive, and consistent with what he's been saying. Worth the hour.
